prompt: Late Tang dynasty study late at night. A breathtakingly handsome young minister continues writing memorials with a traditional Chinese calligraphy brush beneath warm candlelight, completely absorbed in state affairs. Beside him, his five-year-old son has quietly fallen asleep with his head resting upon folded arms. On the white wall behind them, the shadows tell another story: the father's shadow has become a giant tiger curling protectively around the sleeping child, tail wrapped gently around him like a blanket. The tiger watches over the boy with quiet devotion while the man himself remains unaware.
